rules.capture_order: lowest pressed scancode first; ESC is tested before the scan
rules.refuse_unnamed: a scancode outside the bindable set
rules.refuse_duplicate: bound in any other record, or in this record at a slot below the one being captured
rules.valid: set to whether the nine keys of the record are distinct: on RETURN with the keyboard chosen, at the record turn when the record holds the keyboard, and after the ninth capture
rules.exit: ESC leaves the chooser only when every record is valid
rules.device_free: none and keyboard are always free; joystick d is free when d - 2 is an attached joystick no other record holds
rules.cursor_max: the highest free device for record 0 at startup, at least the keyboard

events.name: refuse_exit
events.meaning: ESC on the chooser while a record is invalid

events.name: refuse_unnamed
events.meaning: captured scancode has no key name

events.name: refuse_duplicate
events.meaning: captured scancode is bound to another record or an earlier slot

events.name: back
events.meaning: ESC left the chooser, key list or capture

events.name: enter
events.meaning: RETURN committed a device, or F3/F1 entered a sub-page

events.name: exit
events.meaning: state 9 finished; the page requests OPTIONS

scenarios.name: enter_and_exit
scenarios.description: startup 0 -> 4 -> 1, ESC with every record valid slides out and exits

scenarios.name: device_carousel
scenarios.description: LEFT to none, LEFT clamped, RETURN commits none, F3 ignored off the keyboard, RIGHT back, RIGHT clamped at the highest free device, RETURN re-derives valid

scenarios.name: record_paging
scenarios.description: F1 clamped at record 0, F2 to records 1-3 with the record turn, F2 clamped at 3, F1 back; record 2 carries an unattached joystick and loses it at the turn; record 1 is invalid but unique and the turn re-derives it

scenarios.name: rebind_all_with_refusals
scenarios.description: F3 to the key list, F1 to capture; unnamed F4 and ESC-free refusals, same key on its own slot accepted, another record's key and an earlier slot's key refused, two keys on one tick take the lowest scancode, all nine slots captured, back out and exit

scenarios.name: capture_escape_undo
scenarios.description: record 3: capture two keys then ESC restores all nine; the key list redraws them

scenarios.name: exit_refused_until_valid
scenarios.description: record 1 holds a duplicate and is invalid: ESC croaks; paging keeps it invalid; recapturing record 1 makes it valid and ESC exits

scenarios.name: joystick_choice
scenarios.description: one attached joystick: RIGHT reaches device 2, RETURN commits it, F3 is keyboard only
